subject: computer-science
title: Search Engines and PageRank
welcome_lead: Crawl, index, rank: discover how search engines surface relevant pages.
meta_desc: IBDP HL CS adventure on search engines, indexing and the PageRank algorithm.
final_note: PageRank: a page is important if important pages link to it!

concepts.def: Bot that follows links to discover pages.
Builds inverted index of terms to pages.
Maps terms to document postings list.
Ordering results by relevance and quality.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Start from seed URLs, follow hyperlinks BFS-style.

Respect robots.txt and rate limits to avoid overload.

For each term store list of (docID, frequency).

Allows fast lookup of documents containing a term.

Rank(p) = (1-d)/N + d × Σ Rank(q)/L(q) over links into p.

Iterated until ranks converge.
